time.desc: The university involved issued a review notice: it revoked the sanctions against the accused students and determined that the relevant charges were not established based on judicial conclusions. It also announced that the thesis review concluded that "there were many irregularities but did not constitute academic misconduct" and launched accountability for the relevant responsible persons within the school.
One of the parties involved continuously spoke out against netizens on social platforms and defended themselves, triggering a new round of concentrated attention and public backlash.

One of the parties involved posted on social platforms and quickly denied the statement that he had "passed an important recruitment exam." This statement was widely regarded by public opinion as false information to create a topic and triggered intense questioning.
The university involved issued a review notice to revoke the accused party's punishment and maintain the accuser's degree, and initiate accountability for the relevant responsible persons.
The university involved focused on refuting many key online rumors in the report
The university involved formed a five-member expert team to complete the review and announced the scale of the investigation and the conclusion that the paper did not involve plagiarism.
The accuser spoke out intensively on social platforms to communicate with the outside world and defended himself. The incident was filed in the relevant false accusation theme archives by We Media.
In the review notification, the school suspended the relevant tutors' enrollment qualifications for two years, and gave several managers intra-party warnings or admonishments.

The school issued another notice, confirming that the accuser's paper contained more than 100 irregularities but no academic misconduct was found, and it complied with the degree awarding regulations.

The school established a five-member expert team to complete the reexamination, investigated 21 people, reviewed 91 pieces of evidence, and determined that the paper was not plagiarized and the degree was not revoked.
